requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

643-1486-4231-5291--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Maskwood Nexus, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Cursed Mirror. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Maskwood Nexus, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

1771-2177-8266.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1771-2177-8266.description:
Cast Mana Severance by paying {1}{U}, exiling all lands from your library.
Cast Selective Memory by paying {3}{U}, exiling all remaining cards from your library.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using any creature. Fblthp triggers, causing you to win the game.

483-1417-4279--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
483-1417-4279--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant, Bridge from Below and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Bridge from Below ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3755-4770-5301-5434.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
Rin and Seri triggers, creating a 1/1 Dog creature token.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Dog token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

728-1202-3249-4549.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Myr Moonvessel, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Myr Moonvessel dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Relic of Legends's ability by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Myr Moonvessel from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

2105-5778-7296-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

243-628-728.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Plague Belcher.
When Plague Belcher dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Plague Belcher enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

3129-4365-4772-6763-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3129-4094-4365-6763-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Horizon Explorer.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

129-1978-3980-5793.description:
Activate Sisay's Ring by tapping it, adding two mana.
Kinnan triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Sisay's Ring which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3132-3259-3480.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
3132-3259-3480.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3132-3259-3480.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

101-1987-6573.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
101-1987-6573.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a commander from the command zone two or more times this game.
101-1987-6573.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1987-6573.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

2447-3259-7060.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2447-3259-7060.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf as attackers.
Infestation Expert // Infested Werewolf triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

5078-6650-7753.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
5078-6650-7753.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

372-4125-7339.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-4125-7339.description:
Cast Go Ninja Go by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Shipwreck Dowser and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Shipwreck Dowser trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Go Ninja Go from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Go Ninja Go.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Shipwreck Dowser and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

232-1235-1309-5940.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Return the Favor by paying its mana cost, copying Twinflame, with the copy targeting Priest of Urabrask and Salvager of Secrets.
Resolve the copy of Twinflame, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask and Salvager of Secrets with haste.
When the Priest of Urabrask and Salvager of Secrets tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Return the Favor from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

1495-6774-6919.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Triskelion triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Loading Zone.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
1495-6774-6919.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

uses.exileCardState: with a brain counter on it
with a brain counter on it

1247-3784-5536.description:
Activate Rex using Vhal's ability by tapping it, adding at least {C}{C} that cannot be spent to cast spells from your hand.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

413-2173-5220-6539.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Willow Geist.
When Willow Geist dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Willow Geist from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Willow Geist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Cast Willow Geist from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Bolas's Citadel.
When Willow Geist enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2604-4311-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

1274-3197-3641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3197-3641.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1308-1563-2457-3499.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

527-542-4885.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
527-542-4885.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Tidespout Tyrant triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2797-4853-6291.description:
Activate Retrofitter Foundry's fourth ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Thopter.
When the Thopter dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Retrofitter Foundry.
Resolve the Retrofitter Foundry ability, creating a 4/4 Construct and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

717-2034-4067-5458.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least one card in hand.
An opponent controls a targetable artifact, land or creature.
717-2034-4067-5458.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, targeting an artifact, land or creature an opponent controls.
Marchesa and Bone Miser trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, either adding {B}{B}, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token, or causing you to draw a card.
If you created a Zombie token and your mana pool is empty, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Zombie, adding {C}{C}.
If you drew a card and your mana pool is empty, activate Mind over Matter by discarding a card, targeting any permanent you control, triggering Bone Miser.
Repeat from step 3 until you have resolved all Bone Miser triggers and have at least {1} available.
Resolve the Marchesa trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {1} to look at the top two cards of your library and put one into your hand and the other into your graveyard.
Repeat.

1140-1753-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Staff of Titania attached to any creature you control.
Breath of Fury attached to any creature except Samut or the creature that has Staff of Titania attached that has power 1 or greater.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1140-1753-3259.description:
Declare the creatures with Staff of Titania and Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Staff of Titania triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Forest Dryad token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1881-4487-5220.description:
Cast Phyrexian Marauder either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Phyrexian Marauder enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Marauder on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

141-1379-4483.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least once this game.
141-1379-4483.description:
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Naru Meha.
Echo Storm triggers, creating a copy of itself, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Echo Storm, creating a token copy of Naru Meha.
Put the token Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Naru Meha token's enters-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a copy of Echo Storm, targeting Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.

381-2452-4311-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Gravebane Zombie.
Gravebone Zombie is put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target opponent to mill cards equal to Gravebane Zombie's power.
Cast Gravebane Zombie from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat.

654-774-1671.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting SImic Growth Chamber from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Simic Growth Chamber enters the battlefield, it and Amulet of Vigor trigger.
Resolve the Amulet of Vigor trigger, untapping Simic Growth Chmaber.
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger from step 2, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

253-3591-4695.description:
Activate Necropotence by paying 1 life, exiling the top card of your library face down.
Repeat step 1 until you have zero life.
Activate Soul Conduit by paying {6} and tapping it, exchanging your life total with an opponent's.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
You may repeat this on each of your turns.
